title: Term Life Insurance Claims Manual: Computing the Acceleration Lien
content:
**Term Life Insurance — the lien placed for a terminal illness advance.** The lien is the accelerated amount plus the lien charge, the administrative charge and the premium set aside from the advance, rounded to the cent; the owner is paid the accelerated amount and the lien earns no further interest.

## Inputs from the claim

The elected amount is the amount on the approved accelerated benefit claim, and the physician-certified life expectancy is the one on that claim.

## The accelerated amount

The acceleration room is the product's maximum acceleration amount less the terminal illness advances already paid on this policy. The accelerated amount is the lowest of:

- the elected amount;
- the product's maximum acceleration share of the face amount on record;
- the acceleration room;
- the face amount on record less the product's minimum remaining face.

## Charges

- **Lien charge.** The lien charge rate is the product's acceleration discount rate in full; the lien charge is the accelerated amount times that rate, rounded to the cent.
- **Administrative charge.** The administrative charge before courtesy is the product's acceleration administrative fee and the courtesy share is the whole charge; the administrative charge is the charge before courtesy times the courtesy share, rounded to the cent.

## Premium set aside

The premium months to cover are none, and the months to set aside are the premium months to cover as they are. The premium set aside is the installment premium on record times the number of installments of the premium mode on record (one month each for monthly bank draft, three for quarterly, six for semiannual, twelve for annual) needed to cover the months to set aside, a part installment counting as a whole one. (Counting rule alone, hypothetical: 7 months on a quarterly policy need 3 installments.)

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Ashgrove Level Term 20; face on record 400000; elected amount 250000; no earlier advance on this policy.

| Step | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Maximum share of face | 0.75 of 400000 | 300000.00 |
| Acceleration room | 500000 less nothing | 500000.00 |
| Face less minimum remaining face | 400000 less 10000 | 390000.00 |
| Accelerated amount | lowest of 250000, 300000, 500000, 390000 | 250000.00 |
| Lien charge | 250000.00 times 0.065 | 16250.00 |
| Administrative charge | 150.00 times the whole charge | 150.00 |
| Premium set aside | no months | 0.00 |
| Lien | total | 266400.00 |
